title: Tuple of machine actions
statement: For an action of a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape symbols, and state set $S$, its action tuple is the tuple consisting of the input-head movement, the function assigning each work tape its write instruction and head movement, the optional output bit, and the optional successor state.
